bundle.shortDescription: A modern desktop GUI for controlling Android devices
bundle.longDescription: OpenScrcpy is a modern desktop GUI for controlling Android devices. Mirror the screen, use the phone as a webcam, open a virtual display and route audio from a native Linux, Windows or macOS application.
